case_title: INDER SINGH & ORS. v. STATE OF RAJASTHAN
weapon: Gun, sword, country-made pistol, lathi, gandasi
aggravating_circumstances: Large number of accused, use of weapons, deaths of four persons, serious injuries to informant
trial_court_outcome: Convicted of 24 accused for various offences
neutral_facts: The accused, who were co-villagers, chased and assaulted the victim, resulting in the death of four persons and serious injuries to the informant. The incident occurred in an open field with a large number of witnesses. The accused were armed with various weapons, including guns, swords, and country-made pistols. The informant, who was seriously injured, provided a detailed account of the incident. Medical evidence confirmed multiple firearm injuries on the deceased and the informant. The trial court convicted 24 of the 29 accused, while five were acquitted. The High Court upheld the convictions, and the Supreme Court confirmed the convictions of 16 appellants, while acquitting five others due to lack of sufficient corroboration.
